messages:
oliver_remote: Hey team — quick ask. My start date is Monday but I won’t be in the state until Tuesday. Can I complete the I-9 with a local notary/agent Mon evening? Also I was hired as part-time (20 hrs) — when do benefits and 401k eligibility kick in? And any state tax reciprocity I should be aware of (moving from OR to CA)?

nina_peopleops: Welcome, Oliver! Short answers: a) Yes, we allow an authorized agent/notary for Section 2 if you’re remote — we’ll send the agent packet and form to you. b) Part-time status: medical benefit eligibility starts after 60 days if you average 20+ hours; 401k typically requires 90 days and minimum service hours, we’ll confirm your plan dates. c) State tax: finance_ops, can you weigh in on reciprocity?

finance_ops: For OR→CA: Oregon doesn’t have reciprocity with CA. You’ll be subject to CA withholding once your payroll address is updated. Please submit your new resident address in Workday before the first pay run; if timing is tight we can do a retro adjustment.

oliver_remote: Thanks. If I use a notary, what documents do they need to see? I have a passport and an old SSN card (faded but legible).

nina_peopleops: Agent must inspect originals: passport OR driver’s license + SSN card. If SSN card is hard to read, bring a replacement or bring an alternative 2nd document (birth cert + photo ID) and we can escalate. Upload the signed agent form to Workday and reply here so we can mark I-9 done.

ben_it: FYI laptop scheduled for delivery Mon AM. If you’re not at the address yet, we can hold at vendor pickup or ship to office. Also note: part-time accounts have slightly different default access — DM me if you need full access earlier.

hr_bot: Background check for oliver_remote: IN PROGRESS — expected completion by EOD Monday if no reference delays. Ref: BG-9077.

oliver_remote: Got it. I’ll book a notary for Monday 6pm and upload the form tonight. Any travel stipend if I have to come onsite later for paperwork?

nina_peopleops: We reimburse travel for essential in-person verifications only with manager pre-approval. For a one-time short trip, submit Concur with tag "Onboard-Travel" and request pre-approval via your manager; policy caps economy at $500. I’ll DM the pre-approval template now.

oliver_remote: Perfect — uploading agent form now. Thanks everyone!

hr_bot: Reminder queued: "Check BG + I-9 status for oliver_remote" scheduled 08:00 local on Monday.
